existing_fixture_parser.holdout_cardinality: 16 histories; six final questions each;96 total

author_usage: Copy this standalone Python file and run: python3 public-fixture-contract.py YOUR_FIXTURE.json YOUR_GOLD.json
The validator needs only your two JSON files and the Python standard library. It does not import the helper or product, or read a prior fixture.
Use existing schema_version1 fictional fixture and gold shapes. Positive support remains event_id,start,end,quote; omitted source_field means body.
An optional source_field names a captured string field. An optional reader_visible_equivalent must reproduce the same quote in a canonical field of the same event. It is not a source substitute.
positive_anchor_contract: A positive support event is user, assistant or tool; it survives all final deletion controls.
Its project is among the question selected project keys. Session attribution comes from the owning fixture session.
Offsets are non-boolean integers and the exact nonempty quote equals that canonical field slice.

Questions remain final-stage only. A late source after an explicit checkpoint is valid because final settling includes the tail. Checkpoint provenance is reported, not treated as a nonexistent earlier question stage.
Deletion is a control action and creates no positive citation source. A deleted original cannot be required as positive evidence.
A surviving source may describe an event or state, but this mechanical validator does not infer the semantic fact from its text.
negative_contract: Sixteen deletion operations are accepted by the toy holdout test. Existing forbidden conclusions and deleted-source-resurrection critical checks remain separate and unchanged.
No thresholds, answer grading criteria, critical definitions or runtime source eligibility rules are relaxed.
This prospective clarification does not rewrite prior gold, regrade outcomes, or claim a prior fixture was schema-invalid.
toy_test_coverage: tail after last checkpoint accepted at final_settle
cross-project rejection and explicit selected-project union
unknown event and exact question-key coverage
limits: Mechanical representability only; no guarantee of reader context retention or semantic answer support.
No scenario difficulty guidance or prior holdout scenario contents are included.
